title: GNU IFUNC is the real culprit behind CVE-2024-3094
summary: This repository explores how GNU IFUNC (Indirect Function) mechanism was exploited in the XZ Utils backdoor incident (CVE-2024-3094), demonstrating how the attacker leveraged this linker feature to hide malicious code execution in a sophisticated supply chain attack.
problem_solved: Explains the technical mechanism of how the XZ Utils backdoor was implemented and hidden using GNU IFUNC resolver functions.
why_valuable: Provides critical security research on a real-world supply chain attack technique, helping the security community understand and detect similar exploitation patterns.
